servicesSummary: Embassy of the State of Qatar Registrant continues to provide consulting services in furtherance of the State of Qatar's charitable gift programs. Specifically, Registrant oversees projects, assists with event and partnership planning, and liaises with local government officials in relation to the Qatar Harvey Fund and the Embassy of Qatar's other charitable initiatives. From September 2020, this remit was limited to only the Qatar Harvey Fund and Qatar Haiti Fund projects.
moneyExplanation: The supplemental statement reports $305.00 in total disbursements for this registrant during the filing period. These are registrant-level filing totals and are not automatically attributable to any one foreign principal.
namedPrincipals: Embassy of the State of Qatar

coverage: Registrant-level filing totals are reported only when the form provides an explicit total.
